issue.title: [spark dialect] Parser doesn't handle default value for unix_timestamp function

summary.text: The verifier reproduced the bug with a test that fails before the fix and passes after it, and the tests fail again when the fix is reverted or broken, with no regressions found. The behaviour of the changed module-level code in sqlglot/expressions.py was not compared against the original, so a reviewer should check what uses that value, for example how StrToUnix/unix_timestamp() parses and gener…
